title: Effects of Losartan on Insulin Resistance in Patients With Heart Failure
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the effects of losartan, an ARB, on glucose metabolism and inflammatory cytokines in CHF patients treated with ACE inhibitors.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* chronic stable heart failure

Exclusion Criteria:

* renal dysfunction or under treatment with antidiabetic agents
